references.text: The spies expressed fear of the people in the land and said they were stronger than Israel, the same fear warned against here.
The people feared the nations in Canaan and complained that they could not overcome them.
The following verse gives the answer to the fear expressed in verse 17 and reminds us of God's mighty deeds.
Moses acknowledges that the nations are greater and stronger, but assures the people that God will go before them.
A warning against fearing enemy armies that are larger, because the Lord is with his people.
Moses encourages the people to be strong and not fear, for the Lord goes with them.
God commands Joshua to be strong and courageous, not to fear, since he will lead the people against mighty nations.
God's assurance not to fear because He is with His people and will strengthen them.
The Lord speaks against fear and promises to help Israel like a worm, despite their weakness.
